newsitem.title: USA: Sinclair Broadcast drops public offering.
newsitem.headline: Sinclair Broadcast drops public offering.

text.p: Sinclair Broadcasting Group Inc said Friday it is withdrawing its public offering of 6.25 million shares of Class A common stock because of market conditions.
The company said in a statement that it intends to revive the offer "in the future when market conditions are more favorable."

Instead, the company is considering purchasing outstanding shares of its Class A common stock. Any such repurchases will be made from time to time on the open market and would depend on market conditions, it said.

Sinclair said the withdrawal does not affect a separate shelf registration for the sale of shares of Class A common stock by certain holders who may acquire such shares upon conversion of outstanding shares of Series B convertible preferred stock or upon exercise of certain stock options, all of which were issued in connection with its acquisition of River City Broadcasting of St. Louis for about $1.2 billion.
